profile.name: Alaparthi Yaswanth Kiran
profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | AI Application Developer
profile.summary: I am a Computer Science graduate interested in building web applications, mobile applications, and AI-powered software. I enjoy turning real-world problems into practical software solutions. I have developed applications that combine AI chat interfaces with product recommendations and automatic cart management. I have also built file storage platforms based on practical requirements and worked on modernizing legacy software. During my second year of B.Tech, a friend and I rebuilt an old library management system from scratch while learning PHP and SQL. I am currently exploring Agentic AI, NLP, computer vision, AI automation, and new technologies.
working_style: Learns technologies by implementing real-world solutions
Interested in experimenting with new tools and technologies

projects.name: Pixelify
projects.description: An AI-powered image editing platform focused on making advanced image editing tools accessible for free, with an emphasis on privacy and browser-based processing.
projects.problem: Many users have to pay for basic image editing operations such as background removal and image upscaling. Some users cannot afford expensive subscriptions. Uploading personal images to remote servers can also create privacy concerns.
projects.solution: Developing a privacy-focused image editing platform that aims to perform AI image processing directly on users' devices instead of relying entirely on remote servers.
challenges: Running large AI models within browser memory limitations
Optimizing model inference for devices without dedicated GPUs
Converting AI models into browser-compatible formats
Balancing image quality, performance and memory consumption

projects.name: DIEC-ViT
projects.description: An AI assistant combining tobacco leaf disease diagnosis, computer vision, LLM reasoning and AI-powered product recommendations.
projects.problem: Users need assistance identifying tobacco leaf diseases and finding relevant product recommendations based on their requirements.
projects.solution: Developed an AI-powered system combining computer vision and an agentic workflow with retrieval-augmented generation to provide disease diagnosis and contextual product recommendations.
challenges: Integrating computer vision with LLM-based reasoning

projects.name: Grocery App with AI Chat
projects.description: A mobile shopping application with an AI chat assistant that helps users discover products and manage their shopping cart through natural language conversations.
projects.problem: Finding products and manually managing shopping carts can make the shopping experience less convenient.
projects.solution: Developed an AI-powered shopping assistant that understands product-related questions, suggests relevant products and assists with adding products to the cart automatically.
challenges: Connecting natural language requests with product information
Managing shopping cart operations through an AI assistant

projects.name: AI WhatsApp Auto-Reply Agent
projects.description: An automated WhatsApp communication system that generates context-aware responses using AI and connects messaging with automated workflows.
projects.problem: Responding to incoming messages manually can be time-consuming, especially when similar questions are received repeatedly.
projects.solution: Built an AI-powered WhatsApp auto-reply workflow that connects messaging, AI inference and application logic to generate automated responses.
challenges: Connecting messaging services with AI models

projects.name: SanityHub
projects.description: A web-based file management platform that allows users to upload files and access stored resources from different locations.
projects.problem: Needed a convenient way to store files and retrieve them from anywhere.
projects.solution: Developed a file management application using Next.js and Sanity CMS to handle file uploads and structured cloud storage.

projects.name: Lab Experiment Storage Platform
projects.description: A storage website created to help friends store and access laboratory experiment materials and related resources.
projects.problem: Friends needed a convenient place to store laboratory experiment materials and access them when required.
projects.solution: Built a website based on their requirements to organize and store laboratory-related resources.

projects.name: Library Management System

projects.problem: An existing library management system needed to be modernized and rebuilt.
